thread:
kelly: Quick sprint — we need a tight iteration for the website hero + launch posts that ties to the webinar funnel. Focus: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private. Two routings: webinar sign-up (top-funnel) and demo request (sales-qualified). Who can mock 3 hero variants by EOD?
ajay: I can take two variants. Thinking: Variant A = cost-focused ('Lower inference cost, predictable latency'), Variant B = reliability/SLA-focused ('Production SLAs, global routing').
maria: I'll write microcopy for each: 1) Hosted (fastest time-to-value) 2) Dedicated (reserved throughput) 3) Private (VPC/on-prem). Keep each blurb to 12–15 words.
sam: Quick product note — don't promise specific % cost savings in hero. We can say 'reduce unit cost' or 'cut inference costs' but save the 3x stat for the benchmark narrative and blog/webinar. Also ensure the Dedicated line mentions "burst capacity" and Private mentions "KMS/HSM".
kelly: good call. Ajay — use 'reduce unit cost' in the hero, stash the 3x stat for the webinar headline and launch post.
ajay: noted. For routing: webinar CTA -> /signup?source=web_hero&variant=X ; demo CTA -> /demo-request?source=hero . Want the marketing funnel to tag params for lead scoring.
noah: Ops note on inbound routing — can we standardize the webhook payload so Sales gets model preferences? Example mapping we can push to Pardot/HubSpot:
```
POST /webhook/lead
{
  "email": "...",
  "source": "web_hero",
  "variant": "hosted|dedicated|private",
  "interest": "webinar|demo",
  "traffic_ts": "..."
}
```
We can add a header X-Route: sales or nurture to split leads automatically.
maria: For launch posts and webinar narrative: open with a short benchmark snapshot — 'Our benchmark shows 3x cost reduction vs baseline in steady-state inference'. Follow with a real-world use-case (customer anonymized) and then CTA to webinar + full report. Keep social posts tight (one sentence + link).\elizabeth: :thinking_face: (reacts)
kelly: @sam can you review the benchmark claim copy before we publish? I want one gating review from research.
sam: I'll sign off if the benchmarks use the same model families and seq lengths we publish in the methods. Also want the noise bars visible in the report.
calendar-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Inference Cost & Reliability: Benchmarks and Best Practices" — Wed 11/10 10:00 PT. RSVP link: https://cal.example.com/r/ri-webinar-1110
ajay: For the website experiments, propose this matrix: hero headline (cost vs reliability) x CTA (webinar vs demo). We'll run a 50/50 split for 2 weeks then pick winner for launch posts.
maria: I'll draft 6 social snippets (X, LinkedIn, email subject lines) + one long-form landing paragraph for the webinar landing page.
noah: Also adding lead routing rule snippet for Sales ops team: `if interest == demo -> assign owner = SDR-inbound-demo` else `nurture_sequence = webinar_followup_v1`.
\elizabeth: :thumbsup: (reacts)
kelly: Awesome. Deliverables for EOD: ajay — hero mockups (3 variants); maria — microcopy and 6 social snippets; sam — benchmark copy review; noah — webhook & routing snippet. I'll compile and drop a Figma link here when ready. https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder
ajay: On it. I'll post versions in the thread when done. :rocket:
